scope: retry of an exact wheel after process interruption before release publication

retry.failure: useradd returned exit status 9 because the fixed per-release builder account remained from the interrupted attempt

evidence_sealing: root-owned mode-0444 receipt created before manual cleanup
interpretation: Retry is not idempotent after SIGKILL: the surviving builder account blocks staging the same exact wheel.
The failed retry sealed its newly created temporary directory as incomplete but left the old stage directory and builder account untouched.
This receipt intentionally preserves the pre-cleanup blocker; cleanup and recovery evidence are separate.
limitations: No release tree or unit was published by either attempt.
Only a synthetic package build was used; no Brain state, protected data, or provider credentials were involved.
Process-level injection does not model host power loss or filesystem failure.
